title: How to Watch 2026 MLB All-Star Game Live Online for Free
summary: The 96th annual all-star game takes place on Tuesday (July 14) — watch online for free.
contentText:

At the halfway point of the 2026 season, the best and brightest players in Major League Baseball, such as Vladimir Guerrero Jr., Aaron Judge, Juan Soto and others, are set to play during the 96th edition of the MLB All-Star Game.

It takes place at Citizens Bank Park in Philadelphia, home of the Philadelphia Phillies, on Tuesday (July 14).

Watch Online with DirectV

When Does 2026 MLB All-Star Game Start ?

MLB All-Star Game broadcasts on Tuesday (July 14) with first pitch at 8 p.m. ET/5 p.m. PT. The game airs live on FOX.

Who Is Performing During 2026 MLB All-Star Game?

For 2026, Grammy-winner singer Patti LaBelle performs “The Star-Spangled Banner,” while EGOT winner Jennifer Hudson is scheduled to perform “America the Beautiful” before the game begins. Additionally, Miles Teller narrates a tribute to baseball, and Boyz II Men performs during the Stand Up To Cancer placard moment, a ceremonial pause in the game.

Where to Watch 2026 MLB All-Star Game Online for Free

Baseball fans have a few ways to watch MLB All-Star Game online, especially if you want to watch for free. Online streaming platforms, like DirecTV , Fubo , Hulu + Live TV and others have free trials, so you can watch FOX for free.

DirecTV

Get Five-Day Free Trial

You can stream up to three devices with a subscription to DirecTV , as well as unlimited cloud DVR to record your favorite TV shows to watch back on-demand.

Sling TV

Get Sling Blue

Sling Blue comes with 40+ channels.

A subscription to Sling Blue , which comes with FOX and goes for $45.99 per month, gets you access to live TV. You can watch local networks such as NBC and ABC (in select markets), while you can watch many cable networks too. Please note: Prices and channel availability depend on your local TV market. You can learn more about Sling TV here .

FuboTV

With prices starting at $63.99 per month for the first month of service ($88.99 per month afterward), Fubo’s “Pro” plan is a cable alternative streaming service that offers the MLB All-Star Game broadcast on FOX. The plan features more than 200 other channels, including MLB.TV, MLB Network, FOX Sports, ESPN, ESPN2, NBA TV, NHL Network and others. Fubo comes with a five-day free trial , so you can try out the service before you commit month-to-month.

Hulu + Live TV

Get three-day free trial

Hulu + Live TV comes with Hulu, Disney+ and ESPN Unlimited at no additional cost.

If you don’t have a  Hulu + Live TV subscription, the streamer offers a  free trial  that’ll get you your first three days free to access FOX. Once the free trial is over, you’ll be charged the regular subscription fee starting at $89.99 per month. For even more to watch, Hulu + Live TV bundles with Hulu, Disney+ and ESPN Unlimited at no extra cost to watch even more exclusive and original sporting events and programming.

In the meantime, the 2026 MLB All-Star Game is available to watch on FOX via DirecTV , on Tuesday (July 14) with a start time of 8 p.m. ET/5 p.m. PT.
